### Cutscene 697 - Epilogue 5 - Team Charm - Recruiting Regigigas.txt


def 0 {
    sound_Stop();
    back_SetGround(LEVEL_D32P44A);
    supervision_Acting(0);
    camera_SetMyself<performer 0>();
    screen_FadeIn(1, 30);
    bgm_PlayFadeIn(BGM_IN_THE_DEPTHS_OF_THE_PIT, 0, 256);
    Wait(30);
    message_SetFace(ACTOR_NPC_REJIGIGASU, FACE_NORMAL, FACE_POS_TOP_R_CENTER);
    message_Talk({
        english=" I AM [CS:N]REGIGIGAS[CR]...",
    });
    message_Talk({
        english=" I PLEDGE...SERVICE TO YOU...",
    });
    @label_2;
    CallCommon(CORO_MESSAGE_CLOSE_WAIT_FUNC);
    switch ( ProcessSpecial(PROCESS_SPECIAL_PREPARE_MENU_ACCEPT_TEAM_MEMBER, 9, 0) ) { }
    switch ( message_Menu(MENU_ACCEPT_TEAM_MEMBER) ) {
        case 1:
            @label_0;
            CallCommon(CORO_MESSAGE_CLOSE_WAIT_FUNC);
            me_Play(5);
            message_Mail({
                english="[CN][c_name:NPC_NEW_FRIEND] joined the team!",
            });
            WaitMe(5);
            CallCommon(CORO_MESSAGE_CLOSE_WAIT_FUNC);
            bgm_FadeOut(120);
            screen_FadeOut(1, 60);
            WaitBgm(BGM_IN_THE_DEPTHS_OF_THE_PIT);
            @label_4;
            message_Explanation({
                english="""
                    [CN][player] cleared [CS:P]Aegis Cave[CR]
                    [CN]in admirable fashion!
                """,
            });
            message_Close();
            switch ( ProcessSpecial(55, 58, 0) ) { }
            switch ( message_Menu(MENU_DUNGEON_EXPLORATION_RESULTS) ) { }
            switch ( message_Menu(MENU_DUNGEON_TEAM_RETURNS_FROM_MAP) ) { }
            end;
        case 2:
        default:
            CallCommon(CORO_MESSAGE_CLOSE_WAIT_FUNC);
            message_Mail({
                english="""
                    [CN]Are you sure?[K]
                    [CN]You're sure you won't accept
                    [CN]this potential new member?
                """,
            });
            switch ( message_SwitchMenu(0, 1) ) {
                case menu({
                    english="Reconsider",
                }):
                    jump @label_2;
                case menu({
                    english="Refuse",
                }):
                default:
                    CallCommon(CORO_MESSAGE_CLOSE_WAIT_FUNC);
                    message_Mail({
                        english="""
                            [CN][player] turned down
                            [CN][CS:N]Regigigas[CR]'s offer to join.
                        """,
                    });
                    message_Close();
                    bgm_FadeOut(120);
                    screen_FadeOut(1, 60);
                    WaitBgm(BGM_IN_THE_DEPTHS_OF_THE_PIT);
                    jump @label_4;
            }
            break;
    }
}

            message_Close();
            if ( scn($SCENARIO_SIDE) >= [45, 6] ) {
                @label_2;
                main_EnterDungeon(151, 30);
                main_EnterDungeon(-1, 30);
                hold;
            } else {
                $SCENARIO_SIDE = scn[45, 6];
                jump @label_2;
            }
            break;
        case menu({
            english="No",
        }):
            message_Close();
            end;
    }
}

                break;

                Wait(20);

                    case 1:
                        break_loop;
                        break;

                        continue;  // may be redundant

                break;
        }
    }

    SetEffect(EFFECT_NONE, 3);
    Lock(13);
    hold;

def 1 for actor ACTOR_PLAYER_CHARMS {
    SetAnimation(2);

    Wait(6);

    Lock(6);
    Wait(6);
    Turn2Direction(4, 10, DIR_UP);
    SetEffect(EFFECT_LAUGHING, 3);
    @label_1;
    forever {
        switch ( $EVENT_LOCAL ) {
            case 1:
                break_loop;
                break;
            default:
                WaitRandom(18, 21);
                switch ( $EVENT_LOCAL ) {
                    case 1:
                        break_loop;
                        break;
                    default:
                        Turn2DirectionLives(4, 10, ACTOR_NPC_SAANAITO);
                        WaitRandom(12, 30);
                        switch ( $EVENT_LOCAL ) {
                            case 1:
                                break_loop;
                                break;
                            default:
                                Turn2DirectionLives(4, 10, ACTOR_NPC_CHAAREMU);
                                WaitRandom(18, 21);
                                switch ( $EVENT_LOCAL ) {
                                    case 1:
                                        break_loop;
                                        break;
                                    default:
                                        SetEffect(EFFECT_NONE, 3);
                                        WaitEffect();
                                        SetEffect(EFFECT_JOYOUS, 3);
                                        CallCommon(CORO_JUMP_HAPPY_FUNC);
                                        Turn2DirectionLives(4, 10, ACTOR_NPC_CHAAREMU);
                                        WaitRandom(12, 30);
                                        Turn2DirectionLives(4, 10, ACTOR_NPC_SAANAITO);
                                        CallCommon(CORO_JUMP_HAPPY_FUNC);
                                        SetEffect(EFFECT_NONE, 3);
                                        WaitEffect();
                                        SetEffect(EFFECT_LAUGHING, 3);
                                        switch ( $EVENT_LOCAL ) {
                                            case 1:
                                                break_loop;
                                                break;
                                            default:
                                                continue;  // may be redundant
                                        }
                                        break;
                                }
                                break;
                        }
                        break;
                }
                break;
        }
    }
    @label_0;
    SetEffect(EFFECT_NONE, 3);
    Lock(7);
    hold;
}

                @label_2;
                main_EnterDungeon(142, 30);
                switch ( message_Menu(MENU_DUNGEON_INITIALIZE_TEAM) ) { }

                hold;

                jump @label_2;
            }
            break;
        case menu({
            english="No",
        }):
            message_Close();
            end;
    }

### Cutscene 1086 - Special Episode 5 - In The Future Of Darkness - Continue.txt

    });

        case menu({
            english="Yes",
        }):
        default:
            @label_0;
            CallCommon(CORO_MESSAGE_CLOSE_WAIT_FUNC);
            if ( scn($SCENARIO_SIDE) >= [48, 5] ) {
                @label_2;
                main_EnterDungeon(145, 30);
                switch ( message_Menu(MENU_DUNGEON_INITIALIZE_TEAM) ) { }
                main_EnterDungeon(-1, 30);
                hold;
            } else {
                $SCENARIO_SIDE = scn[48, 5];
                jump @label_2;
            }
            break;
        case menu({
            english="No",
        }):
            message_Close();
            end;
    }
}

            if ( scn($SCENARIO_SIDE) >= [48, 6] ) {
                @label_2;
                main_EnterDungeon(146, 30);

            break;

            end;
    }
}

            break;

            message_Close();
            @label_3;
            end;
    }
